messages.text: The issue is clear: when `parseRange("7")` is called (no hyphen), `text.split("-")` returns `["7"]`, so `to` is `undefined` and `Number(undefined)` is `NaN`. The test expects `{ from: 7, to: 7 }` for a single number.

response.text: The failing test was because `parseRange("7")` (a single number with no hyphen) returned `{ from: 7, to: NaN }` — since splitting `"7"` by `-` produces only one element, `to` was `undefined` and `Number(undefined)` is `NaN`. The fix defaults `to` to the same value as `from` when no second part exists.
